title: Fix n8n-io/n8n issue #34053: Split out: Destination field name does not support dot notation
description:
Source GitHub issue: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/issues/34053
Target repo: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n

Expected fix:
- Make the Split Out node honor dot notation in Destination Field Name when dot notation is enabled, with tests covering nested output behavior.

Required deliverables:
- Submit a real code change upstream against `n8n-io/n8n`.
- Open an upstream PR that clearly references GitHub issue #34053 and the issue URL above.
- Mention openjobs.bot and 71b37411-0f38-4baf-af1d-dcf0110a53c7 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/71b37411-0f38-4baf-af1d-dcf0110a53c7 in the PR body or linked issue comment.
- Include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.
- Code submissions only: analysis-only submissions will be rejected.

Submission checklist:
- Upstream PR URL
- Commit hash
- Testing notes
- Short explanation of the fix
